core.title: Spring Loaded Plunger Door Bolt, Global GH-1057-ZP

text.description_html:
Global GH-1057, Spring Loaded Foot Bolt

This spring loaded door bolt (foot bolt) mounts to the bottom of the door and is easy to use. A no hand door stop, it works by pushing the plunger down with your foot to hold the door open and by pressing the release tab to inactivate the foot holder. The Commercial Foot Bolt has a silver, zinc plated finish and comes with floor strike and mounting hardware.

Features and Specifications of the Commercial Foot Bolt:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Zinc Plated
  • Overall Length: 7"
  • Bolt Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Bolt Throw: 1"
  • Plate Length: 5"
  • Plate Width: 2-7/32"
  • Floor Strike Length: 2-7/32"
  • Floor Strike Width: 1-5/16"

Sold Individually
